newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France cargo expects gradual return to normal.
newsitem.headline: Air France cargo expects gradual return to normal.

text.p: Air France said it expected its cargo services to gradually return to normal from tomorrow morning when a one-day strike by air traffic controllers is scheduled to end.

"The contingency plans we put in place in response to the cancellation of our full-freighter flights, to and from Paris, which involved their transfer to Brussels and Luxembourg , went smoothly," a cargo official for the airline told Reuters.
Air France had placed an embargo on cargo reservations since yesterday but this would be lifted from tomorrow morning at 0800 local time, the official said.

Yesterday Air France cargo activities were hit by a "work to rule" action by personnel, which had been sparked by reports that the airline was considering transforming its freight division into a subsidiary company.
"The latest reports we have is that the action had been called off." the official added.
Senior cargo executives had addressed a works council meeting in order to allay staff fears relating to job losses. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
